title: Spherical grid: two-layer spherical capacitor (analytic)
description:
Electrostatics between two concentric spheres on a spherical (r, theta) domain (coordinates 'spherical', geometry axisymmetric, radius_min = a, theta 0..pi: the whole shell; the drawing is the (r sin theta, r cos theta) half disc about the rotation axis). The inner sphere x_lo is held at V0, the outer x_hi at 0 V; y_lo / y_hi are the axis (no area). Two dielectric layers: eps_1 for a < r < c, eps_2 for c < r < b, painted by circles about the origin; the interface c is a radial cell edge.
Analytic: Q = C V0 with C = 4 pi eps0 / ((1/a - 1/c) / eps_1 + (1/c - 1/b) / eps_2) (whole sphere, in F); D_r = Q / (4 pi r^2) (continuous), E_r = D_r / (eps0 eps_i) (jumps at c), V = V0 - Q (1/a - 1/r) / (4 pi eps0 eps_1) inside c, Q (1/r - 1/b) / (4 pi eps0 eps_2) outside; field energy C V0^2 / 2.
Derived values tab: C_shell (inner charge / voltage, whole-shell charge in C), Q_outer (scalar output charge_outer = -C V0), W_field (integral of E.D / 2 over the metric volumes 2 pi / 3 (r_hi^3 - r_lo^3) (cos theta_lo - cos theta_hi)), V_probe (probe in the inner layer). Expect C and Q ~1e-4 (second order: the 4 pi r_f^2 faces in series, harmonic face mean at the interface), W_field ~1e-3 (cell-centre E and D), V_probe ~1e-4.
Line profile tab: V_ray and E_ray (E_x = the radial component) along the ray theta = pi/4 against the piecewise closed forms (containing-cell image: ~1 % of the range for E).

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: inner sphere voltage [V]; the outer sphere is held at 0 V

parameters.name: c_interface
parameters.description: radius of the layer interface (40 radial cells from a: a cell edge)

parameters.name: eps_1
parameters.description: relative permittivity of the inner layer (alumina-like)

parameters.name: eps_2
parameters.description: relative permittivity of the outer layer (PTFE-like)

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: radial cell size, also the cell length along the outer arc

parameters.name: C_ref
parameters.description: analytic capacitance of the whole spherical capacitor in F

parameters.name: r_probe
parameters.description: probe radius (a radial cell centre in the inner layer)

parameters.name: theta_probe
parameters.description: probe polar angle from the rotation axis (V does not depend on it)

parameters.name: theta_ray
parameters.description: polar angle of the profile ray

analytic_curves.name: V_ray
analytic_curves.expression: where(hypot(x, y) < c_interface, V0 - Q_ref*(1/a_inner - 1/hypot(x, y))/(4*pi*eps0_const*eps_1), Q_ref*(1/hypot(x, y) - 1/b_outer)/(4*pi*eps0_const*eps_2))

analytic_curves.name: E_ray
analytic_curves.expression: Q_ref/(4*pi*eps0_const*where(hypot(x, y) < c_interface, eps_1, eps_2)*(x**2 + y**2))
